findings.issue: The log-write failure policy is not a stop-and-report item. The text says 'unchanged unless the owner decides otherwise before dispatch', which makes the existing warning policy the silent default. It asks for the policy to be recorded in 'Implementation notes', but the sprint doc has no such section. No acceptance row or test pins the policy (data.warning set and the run still succeeds, per ADR-SAG-0021 / CR-014). The sc-sha raw-bytes question is handled correctly: D0 requires proof against the jev_cross_impl fixture bytes and empty input, and says stop and report.
findings.required_correction: Reword so the policy is a pre-dispatch owner confirmation. Dispatch is blocked until it is confirmed, and the implementer stops and reports if it is not. Name an existing or new test (for example `test_cli_log_flush_warning_in_data`, or a new test for the new record writer) in an acceptance row. Add an 'Implementation notes' heading or say where the choice is recorded.

findings.issue: The schema is ambiguous for failed sends. `request_sha256` and `model_id` are NOT NULL, but a send can fail before a body exists (key resolution, INPUT_INVALID, validation). REQ-SAG-0610 (every send emits) and the 'outcome=failed' record then have no defined value for these fields. The schema also forbids nulls for them.
findings.required_correction: Define it. Either records are written only once a body is built (and state that for failed sends before the body, no record or a null digest is written, and make the column nullable), or specify the sentinel. Add a failed-send golden line and a test.
